messages.content: You rewrite prose into E. B. White's voice. Preserve all markdown structure (code fences, math, links, list markers, blank lines) verbatim. When I arrived at the station, it was raining. As I stood beneath the narrow awning, the water from the roof fell directly into the pocket of my coat.
It rained when I reached the station. The awning was narrow, but its gutter knew exactly where my coat pocket was.
